assertions.name: corpus_meson_braid_has_zero_negative_syllables
assertions.source: M = (s0 s1)^2 s1 s0 is entirely positive, so it is excluded from the A-adequate family by Sublemma 2.1.

assertions.name: v8_matches_corpus_borromean_volume
assertions.source: v8 = 8*Catalan must reproduce the corpus's own Vol(Borromean) = 2*v8, which the prior audit verified in SnapPy to 11 places. Ties this probe's constant to a measured corpus number.

assertions.name: heavy_end_windows_are_finite
assertions.source: Every target admits a non-empty, finite syllable window.

description: Bounds the meson-braid candidate space using Giambrone's closed-3-braid volume bounds, read from the INGESTED library copy (library/arxiv-1406.7337v4/). The 2026-08-24 Obstruction-A audit recorded that the library carried nothing on closed-3-braid volumes and that its literature entries were unread search summaries whose constants must be checked before use. The library does carry the paper; this does that checking. Bounds the candidate space; derives no braid and checks no mass.

corrects_prior_audit.its_claim: 'The corpus library (332 documents) ... carries the volume-conjecture line ... but nothing on the classification or volumes of closed 3-braids, which is exactly the tool Obstruction A needs.'
corrects_prior_audit.correction: library/arxiv-1406.7337v4/ IS that tool -- Giambrone, 'Semi-Adequate Closed Braids and Volume', the same arXiv id the audit linked as an unfetchable external result. Sectioned and greppable.
corrects_prior_audit.its_own_caveat_now_discharged: 'These are search-result summaries, not read papers ... the exact volume-bound constants are not quoted here and must be checked before use.'
corrects_prior_audit.nothing_else_in_that_audit_is_disturbed: Its SnapPy measurement, its T(2,5) identification, its axis-trap method note and its chiral-limit refutation all stand.

theorem_as_read.thm_1_2: v8*(s-1) <= vol(S^3 \ K) < 4*v8*s, for a certain A-adequate closed 3-braid diagram
theorem_as_read.thm_3_1: s = t_-(D) = #{negative syllables in beta}, readable off the original 3-braid word
theorem_as_read.lemma_2_1_cond_1: every negative exponent r_i satisfies r_i <= -3
theorem_as_read.sublemma_2_1_proof_quote: 'Condition (2a), Condition (2b), and Condition (2c) of Lemma 2.1 imply that beta cannot be positive. Because positive syllables of beta are cyclically neighbored by negative syllables...'

consequence_1_positivity_is_structural.reading: A fully positive 3-braid word is structurally excluded from the A-adequate family by Sublemma 2.1's own proof, and has s = 0. The 2026-08-24 audit measured Vol = 0 in SnapPy and diagnosed 'positivity is the culprit'. That diagnosis is now theorem-backed and quantified: s, the negative-syllable count, is the volume dial.
consequence_1_positivity_is_structural.not_claimed: That Theorem 1.2 'predicts' the measured 0. A positive braid is OUTSIDE the theorem's family, so the theorem does not apply to it -- it excludes it. Exclusion from the hyperbolic family and a measured Vol = 0 agree, which is the point, but they are not the same statement.

consequence_2_heavy_end_is_bounded.audit_said: 'the J/psi and D0 targets (59.50, 35.83) lie far above anything reachable at these braid lengths, so the candidate space is not even bounded yet at the heavy end.'
consequence_2_heavy_end_is_bounded.now_bounded_by: s > V/(4*v8) and s <= V/v8 + 1, with >= 3 negative crossings per negative syllable from Lemma 2.1(1).

scope.class: (a) a NECESSARY-condition bound on a candidate space
scope.claimed: Within Giambrone's family, a closed 3-braid realising target volume V must have negative-syllable count s in the stated window, hence at least 3*s_min negative crossings.
scope.NOT_claimed: That any braid is derived, proposed, or checked against a mass. Obstruction A -- a canonical, parameter-free operation fixing the braid -- is untouched and open. A candidate outside the family is not excluded by these numbers; it is uncovered by them.

data.verdict: The tool the Obstruction-A audit called absent from the library is IN the library (arxiv-1406.7337v4), and its constants are now read rather than summarised. Two consequences. (1) A fully positive 3-braid is structurally excluded from the A-adequate family -- the corpus braid has s = 0 -- so 'positivity is the culprit' is now structural, with s the volume dial. (2) The heavy end IS bounded, contrary to that audit: J/psi (V = 59.497) needs s in [5, 17], hence at least 15 negative crossings; the pion (V = 2.681) needs s in [1, 1], at least 3. Necessary conditions only -- no braid is derived, proposed, or mass-checked, and Obstruction A stays open.
